<div class="function-explorer">

::: {.callout-note}
## Explore reporting functions

1. Search by function name, description, or keyword.
2. Filter by the fields available in your cleaned dataset, language, or output type.
3. Select **View details** to inspect requirements, attribution, and a sample output.
4. Follow the GitHub Issue link to review build history or contribute another language version.
:::

<details class="function-explorer__code-drawer">
<summary>View Source Code</summary>

The complete ObservableJS logic is available in
[`function_explorer.qmd`](https://github.com/shannonrankin/glider-reporter/blob/main/function_explorer.qmd)
for inspection or copying.

</details>

## Find a function

<div class="function-explorer__filters">

<div class="function-explorer__search">

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_search = Inputs.text({
  label: "Keyword search",
  placeholder: "Search titles, descriptions, or keywords"
})
```

</div>

```{ojs}
function_explorer_registry = JSON.parse(
  await FileAttachment("functions/registry.json").text()
)

function_explorer_standard_fields = (
  await FileAttachment("data/standard_fields.csv").csv()
).map((entry) => entry.standard_field).filter(Boolean)

function_explorer_chip_input = (
  options,
  {label, multiple = false, value, modifier}
) => {
  const form = function_explorer_element(
    "form",
    `function-explorer__filter-card function-explorer__chip-filter function-explorer__chip-filter--${modifier}`
  );
  const fieldset = function_explorer_element("fieldset", "");
  const legend = function_explorer_element("legend", "", label);
  const chips = function_explorer_element("div", "function-explorer__chips");
  let selected = multiple ? [...value] : value;

  const update = () => {
    for (const button of chips.querySelectorAll("button")) {
      const active = multiple
        ? selected.includes(button.value)
        : selected === button.value;
      button.classList.toggle("function-explorer__chip--active", active);
      button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
    }
    form.value = multiple ? [...selected] : selected;
  };

  for (const option of options) {
    const button = function_explorer_element(
      "button",
      "function-explorer__chip",
      option
    );
    button.type = "button";
    button.value = option;
    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
      if (multiple) {
        selected = selected.includes(option)
          ? selected.filter((item) => item !== option)
          : [...selected, option];
      } else {
        selected = option;
      }
      update();
      form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    });
    chips.append(button);
  }

  fieldset.append(legend, chips);
  form.append(fieldset);
  update();
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_required_fields = function_explorer_chip_input(
  function_explorer_standard_fields,
  {label: "Required fields", multiple: true, value: [], modifier: "fields"}
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_language = function_explorer_chip_input(
  ["All", "R", "Python", "Quarto", "MATLAB", "Julia", "Pseudo-code"],
  {label: "Language", value: "All", modifier: "language"}
)
```

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_output_type = function_explorer_chip_input(
  ["All", "Figure/Plot", "Table", "Summary Text"],
  {label: "Output type", value: "All", modifier: "output"}
)
```

</div>

```{ojs}
function_explorer_matches = {
  const query = function_explorer_search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const selectedFields = function_explorer_required_fields || [];

  return function_explorer_registry.filter((entry) => {
    const searchableText = [
      entry.name,
      entry.description,
      ...(entry.keywords || [])
    ].join(" ").toLowerCase();
    const requiredFields = entry.required_fields || [];

    return (!query || searchableText.includes(query))
      && selectedFields.every((field) => requiredFields.includes(field))
      && (function_explorer_language === "All"
        || entry.language === function_explorer_language)
      && (function_explorer_output_type === "All"
        || entry.output_type === function_explorer_output_type);
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
function_explorer_element = (tagName, className, text) => {
  const element = document.createElement(tagName);
  if (className) element.className = className;
  if (text !== undefined) element.textContent = text;
  return element;
}

function_explorer_issue_link = (entry, className, text) => {
  const link = function_explorer_element(
    "a",
    className,
    text
  );
  link.href = entry.issue_url;
  link.target = "_blank";
  link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
  return link;
}

function_explorer_function_link = (entry, className, text) => {
  const link = function_explorer_element("a", className, text);
  link.href = entry.function_file;
  link.download = entry.function_file.split("/").pop();
  return link;
}

function_explorer_tag = (text, modifier = "") => function_explorer_element(
  "span",
  `function-explorer__tag${modifier ? ` ${modifier}` : ""}`,
  text
)
```

## Available functions

```{ojs}
viewof function_explorer_active_id = {
  const form = document.createElement("form");
  form.className = "function-explorer__navigation";
  const options = new Map(
    function_explorer_matches.map((entry) => [entry.name, entry.id])
  );
  const select = Inputs.select(options, {label: "Function details"});
  const controls = function_explorer_element(
    "div",
    "function-explorer__navigation-controls"
  );
  const previous = function_explorer_element(
    "button",
    "function-explorer__navigation-button",
    "Previous (←)"
  );
  const next = function_explorer_element(
    "button",
    "function-explorer__navigation-button",
    "Next (→)"
  );

  Object.defineProperty(form, "value", {
    get() {
      return select.value;
    }
  });

  const move = (offset) => {
    const index = function_explorer_matches.findIndex(
      (entry) => entry.id === select.value
    );
    const nextIndex = (index + offset + function_explorer_matches.length)
      % function_explorer_matches.length;
    select.value = function_explorer_matches[nextIndex].id;
    select.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  };

  previous.type = "button";
  previous.disabled = function_explorer_matches.length === 0;
  previous.addEventListener("click", () => move(-1));
  next.type = "button";
  next.disabled = function_explorer_matches.length === 0;
  next.addEventListener("click", () => move(1));
  select.addEventListener(
    "input",
    () => form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}))
  );
  controls.append(previous, next);
  form.append(select, controls);
  return form;
}
```

```{ojs}
function_explorer_saved_selection = {
  try {
    const selectedIds = JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem("glider_reporter_selected_functions") || "[]"
    );
    return Array.isArray(selectedIds) ? selectedIds : [];
  } catch {
    return [];
  }
}

viewof function_explorer_selection = {
  const form = document.createElement("form");
  form.className = "function-explorer__selection-list";
  const selectedIds = new Set(function_explorer_saved_selection);

  Object.defineProperty(form, "value", {
    get() {
      return [...selectedIds];
    }
  });

  for (const entry of function_explorer_matches) {
    const label = function_explorer_element(
      "label",
      "function-explorer__selection"
    );
    const checkbox = document.createElement("input");
    checkbox.type = "checkbox";
    checkbox.checked = selectedIds.has(entry.id);
    checkbox.addEventListener("change", () => {
      if (checkbox.checked) selectedIds.add(entry.id);
      else selectedIds.delete(entry.id);
      localStorage.setItem("glider_reporter_selected_functions", JSON.stringify([...selectedIds]));
      form.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
    });
    label.append(
      checkbox,
      function_explorer_element("span", "", `${entry.name} — Select for Report`)
    );
    form.append(label);
  }
  return form;
}

function_explorer_selected = function_explorer_selection

function_explorer_selected_entry = function_explorer_matches.find(
  (entry) => entry.id === function_explorer_active_id
)
```

```{ojs}
function_explorer_catalog = {
  const catalog = function_explorer_element("section", "function-explorer__catalog");
  const resultLabel = function_explorer_element(
    "p",
    "function-explorer__result-count",
    `${function_explorer_matches.length} function${function_explorer_matches.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} found`
  );
  resultLabel.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  catalog.append(resultLabel);

  if (!function_explorer_selected_entry) {
    catalog.append(function_explorer_element(
      "p",
      "function-explorer__empty",
      "No functions match these filters. Try removing a filter or using a broader search."
    ));
    return catalog;
  }

  const entry = function_explorer_selected_entry;
  const card = function_explorer_element(
    "article",
    "function-explorer__detail-card"
  );
  const title = function_explorer_element("h3", "", entry.name);
  const tags = function_explorer_element("div", "function-explorer__tags");
  tags.append(
    function_explorer_tag(entry.language),
    function_explorer_tag(entry.output_type),
    function_explorer_tag(
      entry.translation_status === "ready" ? "Ready" : "Needs translation",
      entry.translation_status === "ready"
        ? "function-explorer__tag--ready"
        : "function-explorer__tag--translation"
    )
  );
  const description = function_explorer_element("p", "", entry.description);
  const requirementsHeading = function_explorer_element(
    "h4",
    "",
    "Operational requirements"
  );
  const requirements = function_explorer_element(
    "p",
    "",
    entry.execution_instructions
  );
  const fieldsHeading = function_explorer_element("h4", "", "Required input fields");
  const fieldList = function_explorer_element("ul", "function-explorer__field-list");
  for (const field of entry.required_fields || []) {
    fieldList.append(function_explorer_element("li", "", field));
  }
  const codeHeading = function_explorer_element("h4", "", "Function code");
  const code = document.createElement("code");
  code.className = `language-${entry.language.toLowerCase()}`;
  const codeBlock = document.createElement("pre");
  codeBlock.className = "function-explorer__code";
  code.textContent = "Loading function code…";
  codeBlock.append(code);
  fetch(new URL(entry.function_file, document.baseURI))
    .then((response) => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Unable to load ${entry.function_file}.`);
      return response.text();
    })
    .then((source) => {
      const match = source.match(/## Code\s*\n+```\w*\n([\s\S]*?)```/);
      code.textContent = match ? match[1].trim() : "No code block is available.";
    })
    .catch(() => {
      code.textContent = "Function code could not be loaded.";
    });
  const previewHeading = function_explorer_element("h4", "", "Sample output");
  const preview = document.createElement("img");
  preview.className = "function-explorer__preview";
  preview.src = `data/precomputed_outputs/${encodeURIComponent(entry.id)}.png`;
  preview.alt = `Pre-computed sample output for ${entry.name}`;
  preview.loading = "lazy";
  const previewUnavailable = function_explorer_element(
    "p",
    "function-explorer__preview-unavailable",
    "A pre-computed preview is not available for this function."
  );
  previewUnavailable.hidden = true;
  preview.addEventListener("error", () => {
    preview.hidden = true;
    previewUnavailable.hidden = false;
  });
  const citationHeading = function_explorer_element(
    "h4",
    "",
    "Citation & methodology"
  );
  const citation = function_explorer_element(
    "p",
    "function-explorer__citation",
    entry.citation || "No citation supplied."
  );
  card.append(
    title, tags, description, requirementsHeading, requirements, fieldsHeading,
    fieldList, codeHeading, codeBlock, previewHeading, preview, previewUnavailable,
    citationHeading, citation,
    function_explorer_issue_link(
      entry,
      "function-explorer__issue-link",
      "View Build History on GitHub"
    ),
    function_explorer_function_link(
      entry,
      "function-explorer__issue-link",
      "Download Function Source"
    )
  );
  catalog.append(card);
  return catalog;
}
```

```{ojs}
function_explorer_report_action = {
  const container = function_explorer_element(
    "div",
    "function-explorer__report-action"
  );
  const status = function_explorer_element(
    "p",
    "function-explorer__selection-status",
    `${function_explorer_selected.length} function${function_explorer_selected.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} selected and staged for report generation.`
  );
  status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  const button = function_explorer_element(
    "button",
    "function-explorer__report-button",
    "Move Selected Functions to Report Builder (→)"
  );
  button.type = "button";
  button.disabled = function_explorer_selected.length === 0;
  button.addEventListener("click", () => {
    localStorage.setItem("glider_reporter_selected_functions", JSON.stringify(function_explorer_selected));
    window.location.assign("report_builder.qmd");
  });
  container.append(status, button);
  return container;
}
```
